title: FIS AML Investigations Agent Now Commercially Available to Help Banks Tackle the Scale and Cost of Financial Crime Compliance
summary:
FIS®  today announced that the FIS AML Investigations Agent that was jointly announced in May 2026 with Anthropic, is now commercially available to any U.S.-based bank, including those that are not FIS clients today. This is the first solution of its kind from a provider that already operates the core banking, payments and data infrastructure financial crime investigations depend on, with built-in controls that keep analysts in command of every decision.
FIS built the agent with support from Anthropic and design partner Amalgamated Bank. The agent is now being deployed at Amalgamated.
The scale of the challenge is significant. U.S. financial institutions spend an estimated $35 to $40 billion a year on anti-money laundering operations (LexisNexis, 2023), yet analysts devote 40 to 60 percent of investigation time to assembling data before analysis can begin (AnChain.AI, 2025). Industry false-positive rates run between 90 and 95 percent (Datos Insights, 2023). Alert volumes keep climbing. The gap is not analytical capacity - it is the manual evidence assembly that consumes it.
Based on Amalgamated’s analysis of its investigation workflows combined with the AML Investigations Agent’s expected abilities, the agent is projected to reduce Level 1 alert review time by more than 90 percent, Level 2 case investigation time by approximately 98 percent, and SAR narrative preparation time by more than 80 percent - freeing investigators to redirect capacity from data assembly to complex cases that require greater judgment.
The agent applies customer-specific context to every investigation rather than treating all alerts the same. It maps the customer’s type, historical activity and expected behavior against the alert before assembling evidence, so the resulting summary is already calibrated to what is and is not normal for that customer. A seasonal spike in cash deposits looks different from deposits deliberately kept just under federal reporting thresholds. A routine international transfer looks different from an unexplained cross-border wire to a high-risk jurisdiction. The agent identifies those distinctions and explains the rationale to the analyst.
The agent is built on FIS’ Trust Assured framework, which embeds governance, compliance and responsible AI into every FIS product. Every output links to the specific record, document or check image it came from. Every recommendation, the reasoning behind it and the analyst's final decision are logged in a complete audit trail, so investigation outcomes are explainable and ready for internal audit or regulatory examination. Each institution's risk logic, thresholds and investigation procedures remain isolated through the FIS Control Plane, FIS's governance layer for managing agent access, controls and institution-specific configurations. The agent is designed to augment, not replace, the monitoring platforms and case management systems a bank already runs, and natively integrates with FIS Horizon and FIS Systematics, two of FIS core banking platforms, with FIS IBS planned next on the product roadmap.
“Investigations don’t slow down because analysts lack judgment. They slow down because evidence is scattered across systems and every alert gets treated the same,” said Stan Szwalbenest, Head of Enterprise Fraud and Financial Crimes, FIS. “By bringing together the core, payments and data these investigations rely on, FIS gives analysts a head start while keeping them in control of every decision.”
“AML investigations require comprehensive evidence and experienced judgment. The FIS AML Investigations Agent can reduce time spent gathering information and preparing documentation, allowing investigators to focus on complex cases and critical decisions. Each recommendation has a clear audit trail, while the investigator remains accountable for the final determination. In regulated environments, AI must strengthen human expertise while preserving trust and governance,” said Sean Searby, Chief Information & Operations Officer, Amalgamated Bank.
FIS developed and owns the AML Investigations Agent, built with support from an Anthropic team that embedded with FIS product and compliance teams, drawing on FIS’ financial-institution relationships, regulatory expertise and transaction-data infrastructure. The collaboration also produced the evaluation frameworks and engineering practices FIS will use to build and scale additional agents on the same governed platform. The agent runs in FIS’ private cloud and uses Anthropic’s Claude models.

title: Iberdrola, BBVA and Santander Deliver the First Syndicated Financing Managed Entirely on Blockchain
summary:
Iberdrola, BBVA and Santander arranged a €150 million corporate syndicated financing facility, managed entirely using distributed ledger technology (DLT), commonly known as blockchain. The transaction marks a milestone for the financial market as the first live syndicated loan whose entire lifecycle, from execution and disbursement through to the management of interest, waivers, repayments, assignments and maturity, is administered using this technology. The transaction aligns with Iberdrola’s digital transformation strategy, which places innovation, data and emerging technologies at the heart of its efforts to drive efficiency and streamline financial and treasury processes. Gómez-Acebo & Pombo acted as legal advisers on the transaction.
The digital infrastructure enables participating institutions to share and maintain a single, synchronised and immutable record of information, replacing reconciliation processes between separate databases with a single shared source of information. This technology improves transaction traceability, reduces the risk of operational errors and facilitates more efficient management of syndicated financing, enabling the various participants to interact in an orderly manner under the operational control of the agent bank appointed for the financing.
Throughout the life of the loan, the platform manages the main contractual events in a coordinated manner, including the calculation and notification of interest, payments of principal and fees, early repayments, monitoring compliance with agreed financial covenants and information undertakings, the processing of certain contractual consents, and transfers of participations between lending institutions. All these events are recorded on the DLT infrastructure and are visible in real time to authorised participants.
The application of distributed ledger technology to the syndicated loan market makes it possible to simplify the management of financing lifecycles, reduce operating costs, improve coordination between institutions and increase the efficiency of one of the most important segments of corporate financing. It may also help increase market liquidity and facilitate access to this type of financing for mid-sized companies by simplifying processes that have traditionally limited their participation in these transactions.
The transaction was managed through the platform developed by ioBuilders with the support of BBVA and Santander to digitalise the management of syndicated financing. Following this first transaction, the institutions will work on progressively onboarding new participants and expanding the platform’s functionalities, with the aim of moving towards a shared infrastructure for the syndicated loan market. The goal is to harness the potential of distributed ledger technology to modernise one of the most important markets in corporate finance, traditionally characterised by a high administrative burden and intensive coordination among multiple participants, including the agent bank, lending banks and the client.
Rob Kay, Global Head of Investment Grade and Emerging Markets Debt at Santander CIB, said: “Innovation is part of Santander’s DNA. This transaction represents an important step forward in the evolution of syndicated financing, demonstrating how DLT-based technologies can bring greater efficiency, transparency and traceability to complex financial processes. It also highlights how digital assets are already generating tangible value for the business and contributing to the transformation of financial markets. At the same time, it lays the foundations for an industry collaboration model with the potential to redefine different aspects of corporate financing.”
Alberto Falco, Head of Portfolio Monitoring and Innovation at BBVA CIB, said: “This transaction reflects BBVA’s commitment to the digitalisation of financial markets. Blockchain technology enables a particularly significant transformational leap in syndicated loans, a product that has traditionally seen limited digitalisation and has been accessible to very few clients. By combining the advantages of DLT as an immutable record with the programmability of smart contracts to automate operational processes, our ambition is for this platform to become a meeting point that other institutions can join to help drive the syndicated loan market.”
“The adoption of blockchain technology in financial environments is increasingly becoming a reality thanks to the benefits it provides. With this transaction, we demonstrate that these advantages can also be extended to a live syndicated loan and its end-to-end management, with full legal validity and based on a single source of information shared by all parties. It is also worth highlighting that the technology underpinning this platform opens the door to more efficient management of financial institutions’ balance sheets, enabling new strategies for loan mobilisation in the secondary market,” said Carlos Matilla, CEO of ioBuilders.

title: Industry and Government Back CFIT Financial Inclusion Coalition
summary:
After the Economic Secretary to the Treasury’s welcomed CFIT’s Financial Inclusion Coalition at the Fintech as a Force for Good conference in London last week, CFIT is today announcing that several major UK banks – including Natwest, Nationwide and HSBC UK - will participate in the Coalition, highlighting Government and industry support for the initiative to develop a new Supported Payments framework.
The announcement demonstrates the growing momentum behind the coalition, bringing together Government, major financial institutions, regulators, technology providers, the Third Sector and people with lived experience around a shared ambition to tackle a longstanding systemic challenge in the UK. 
A significant number of people need help from someone they trust to manage everyday payments, including people with learning disabilities and others who may need support while retaining the ability to make their own financial decisions. Current banking arrangements do not adequately support this need. As a result, people and their supporters can be pushed towards informal and potentially unsafe workarounds, including sharing cards, PINs or online banking credentials.
The framework will address the gap between managing finances entirely independently and formal arrangements such as Power of Attorney or deputyship. The aim is to increase independence and control while providing appropriate safeguards for customers, trusted third parties, and financial services providers. 
From Project Nemo to practical delivery
The Financial Inclusion Coalition builds on more than two years of work led by Project Nemo, which grew from a grassroots initiative focused on disability inclusion into a wider crosssector movement bringing together banks, fintechs, charities, policymakers, regulators and, critically, people with lived experience.
In a major research publication, led by Nationwide, Project Nemo helped identify a significant gap in the way financial services support people who need assistance managing their money. For many, the current options can fall between managing finances entirely independently, relying on informal and potentially risky arrangements such as sharing passwords or PINs, or moving to formal legal mechanisms such as Power of Attorney or deputyship.
This work helped build wider recognition of the need for change. HM Treasury’s Financial Inclusion Strategy recognised Project Nemo’s work identifying barriers faced by disabled consumers, with Government subsequently providing funding to CFIT to take the work forward. The launch of CFIT’s Financial Inclusion Coalition with Project Nemo at Money20/20 Europe marked the next stage in that journey: moving from identifying the problem and mobilising the industry towards developing, testing and ultimately implementing a practical solution.
The Coalition is now developing a Supported Payments framework, bringing together financial institutions, technology providers, Government, regulators, the Third Sector and people with lived experience. The aim is to establish how trusted third-party support could work safely in practice – giving people appropriate help with everyday payments while allowing them to retain as much independence, choice and control as possible. 
That progression is important to the wider CFIT story: Project Nemo helped surface the challenge and build the case for action; Government recognised the issue and provided support; CFIT is now bringing the ecosystem together to turn that momentum into a practical, scalable solution.
From industry mobilisation to practical delivery
Throughout the remainder of 2026, Coalition participants will undertake a series of focused sprints to develop a Trust & Governance Framework and test key elements of the Supported Payments model, including digital identity verification and approaches to assessing a customer’s ability to use the service. 
Crucially, people with lived experience will be directly involved in designing and testing the proposed customer journey. 
This work will culminate in an Interim Report later this year, setting out the Coalition’s initial findings and Trust & Governance Framework, and informing the next phase of the programme which will focus on building and testing a Minimum Viable Product for Supported Payments.
Anna Wallace, CEO of CFIT, said: “For too many people, getting help to manage their money still means giving up more control than they should have to. Tackling that challenge requires coordinated action across the industry. CFIT is here to do exactly that: marshal the expertise, commitment and resources needed to move beyond recognising the problem to developing and testing practical solutions that deliver meaningful change.”

title: Smarsh Taps Former ACI Worldwide Executive Alessandro Silva as Chief Growth Officer to Drive Its Next Phase of Global Expansion

The move comes as organizations worldwide face rising volumes of digital communications, new forms of AI-driven collaboration, and increasingly complex regulation. A unified go-to-market organization will speed decision-making, deliver a more consistent customer experience, and still adapt to the needs of different industries, regions, and regulatory environments.

Silva joins from ACI Worldwide, where as Chief Revenue Officer he led the global commercial organization, including sales effectiveness, go-to-market strategy, and customer success. He previously held senior sales and general management roles at Western Union, GE Capital, and The Carlyle Group.
"Growth may be my mandate, but it is a shared mission, and every team across Smarsh has a role in achieving it," said Silva. "My focus is turning our strengths into a connected commercial strategy that helps us serve customers more effectively and scale with greater speed and consistency."
Momentum behind the appointment
Silva joins as Smarsh sets the pace for AI innovation in communications data and intelligence. In 2026, Smarsh launched Discovery Agent, its MCP Server, AskSmarsh AI, and MySearch Agent, and extended capture to Claude Enterprise, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Workspace so regulated firms can adopt AI with confidence. content_ta: Spend மற்றும் expense management சேவைகளை வழங்கி வரும் financial operations platform ஆன Extend, தனது புதிய AI Receipt Agent-ஐ bank partners மற்றும் அவர்களின் SMB customers பயன்பாட்டிற்காக அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. வணிகங்கள் நம்பகமான artificial intelligence tools-ஐ எளிதாகப் பெறும் வகையில் Extend இந்த நடவடிக்கையை எடுத்துள்ளது.

title: Pineapple Financial rebrands as Pentiv; unveils agents for mortgage brokers
summary: Pentiv (NYSE American: PAPL), the new operating brand of Pineapple Financial Inc., today announced the launch of its intelligence platform for mortgage agents and brokerages, marking the next phase of the company’s evolution.
content: Pineapple Financial Inc. has officially rebranded as Pentiv, trading under the NYSE American ticker PAPL. Alongside the name change, the company announced the launch of a new intelligence platform specifically designed for mortgage agents and brokerages, marking an important new phase in the firm's ongoing corporate evolution and service offerings.
content_ta: Pineapple Financial Inc. நிறுவனம் தனது பெயரை அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக Pentiv என்று மாற்றியுள்ளது. மேலும், NYSE American சந்தையில் PAPL என்ற குறியீட்டின் கீழ் வர்த்தகம் செய்யப்படும் இந்நிறுவனம், மோர்கெஜ் ஏஜெண்டுகள் மற்றும் புரோக்கரேஜ்களுக்காக பிரத்யேகமாக உருவாக்கப்பட்ட புதிய நுண்ணறிவு தளத்தை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது.

title: Account-to-Account Payments in the UK: What Comes Next?
summary: At Sibos 2026, Nationwide and Form3 talk about banks navigating the UK's Retail Payments Infrastructure Board (RPIB) transition and how financial institutions can manage the exploding payment rail complexity.
content: At Sibos 2026, Nationwide and Form3 discussed the future of account-to-account payments in the UK. The conversation focused on how financial institutions are navigating the Retail Payments Infrastructure Board transition and managing increasing payment rail complexity in the region.
content_ta: Sibos 2026 மாநாட்டில், Nationwide மற்றும் Form3 நிறுவனங்கள் UK-இன் account-to-account payments எதிர்காலம் குறித்து விவாதித்தனர். Retail Payments Infrastructure Board மாற்றத்தை வங்கிகள் எவ்வாறு கையாள்வது மற்றும் payment rail சிக்கல்களை நிர்வகிப்பது குறித்து இதில் பேசப்பட்டது.

title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
summary: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.
content: Sweden's Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona. This move comes as the European Central Bank advances its own plans for a digital euro. The Swedish central bank cited concerns regarding foreign-currency stablecoins and the future security of domestic payments, prompting a renewed focus on state-backed digital currency options.
content_ta: டிஜிட்டல் krona தொடர்பான சாத்தியக்கூறுகளுக்குச் சட்டமியற்றுபவர்கள் தயாராகுமாறு Sweden-இன் Riksbank பரிந்துரைத்துள்ளது. European Central Bank தனது digital euro திட்டங்களை முன்னெடுத்து வரும் நிலையில் இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. வெளிநாட்டு கரன்சி stablecoins மற்றும் உள்நாட்டுப் பணப்பரிமாற்றங்களின் எதிர்காலம் குறித்த கவலைகளைச் Sweden மத்திய வங்கி சுட்டிக்காட்டியுள்ளது.

title: Bitcoin slips under $80K after US PPI gains most in four years
summary: BTC buyers attempted to defend $80,000 support after September US producer inflation overshot expectations by 100 basis points for the largest monthly gain since March 2022
content: Bitcoin dropped below $80,000 as buyers attempted to defend the support level. The downturn followed September US producer inflation data, which recorded its largest monthly gain since March 2022 after overshooting expectations by 100 basis points.
content_ta: செப்டம்பர் மாத US தயாரிப்பாளர் பணவீக்கம் எதிர்பார்ப்புகளை விட அதிகமாக பதிவானதைத் தொடர்ந்து, வாங்குவோர் ஆதரவு நிலையைப் பாதுகாக்க முயன்றதால் Bitcoin விலை $80,000-க்கு கீழே சரிந்தது. மார்ச் 2022-க்குப் பிறகு இதுவே மிகப்பெரிய மாதாந்திர உயர்வாகும்.

title: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
summary: Hot inflation data revived Fed rate-hike bets, and leveraged bulls paid the bill as nearly $1 billion in crypto positions were liquidated.
content: Bitcoin experienced extreme volatility following the release of hot inflation data, which revived expectations of Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. The sudden market shift impacted leveraged positions, resulting in nearly $1 billion in crypto liquidations across the market as bullish traders were forced out.
content_ta: சூடான பணவீக்க தரவுகள் வெளியானதைத் தொடர்ந்து Fed வட்டி விகித உயர்வு குறித்த எதிர்பார்ப்புகள் மீண்டும் எழுந்ததால், Bitcoin விலையில் கடும் ஏற்றத்தாழ்வு ஏற்பட்டது. இந்த திடீர் சந்தை மாற்றத்தால் அதிக அளவில் கடன் பெற்று முதலீடு செய்தவர்கள் பாதிக்கப்பட்டு, சந்தையில் கிட்டத்தட்ட $1 பில்லியன் அளவுக்கு crypto நிலைகள் liquidated செய்யப்பட்டன.

title: CleanSpark and BitFuFu see bitcoin production slip in September as Canaan remains flat
summary: CleanSpark is ending monthly mining reports, while BitFuFu faces uncertainty over its Ethiopia deal.
content: Bitcoin mining companies CleanSpark and BitFuFu experienced a decline in their bitcoin production during the month of September, while Canaan's production remained steady. CleanSpark announced it will be ending its practice of issuing monthly mining reports. Meanwhile, BitFuFu is navigating uncertainty surrounding its operational deal in Ethiopia.
content_ta: செப்டம்பர் மாதத்தில் CleanSpark மற்றும் BitFuFu ஆகிய பிட்காயின் மைனிங் நிறுவனங்களின் பிட்காயின் உற்பத்தி குறைந்துள்ளது, அதே நேரத்தில் Canaan நிறுவனத்தின் உற்பத்தி மாறாமல் உள்ளது. இனி மாதாந்திர மைனிங் அறிக்கைகளை வெளியிடப்போவதில்லை என்று CleanSpark அறிவித்துள்ளது. இதற்கிடையில், எத்தியோப்பியாவில் உள்ள அதன் ஒப்பந்தம் தொடர்பாக BitFuFu நிறுவனம் நிச்சயமற்ற தன்மையை எதிர்கொண்டு வருகிறது.

title: Multiliquid, a settlement platform for tokenized assets, raises $8 million
summary:
Multiliquid's funding could enhance liquidity in tokenized markets, potentially accelerating institutional adoption and transforming financial systems.
The post Multiliquid raises $8 million to expand liquidity in $40 billion tokenized asset market appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Multiliquid, a settlement platform focused on tokenized assets, has successfully raised $8 million in funding. The new capital will be used to expand liquidity within the growing market for tokenized assets. Industry experts note this development could help accelerate institutional adoption and drive further transformation across traditional financial systems.
content_ta: டோக்கனைஸ் செய்யப்பட்ட சொத்துக்களுக்கான செட்டில்மெண்ட் பிளாட்ஃபார்மான Multiliquid, $8 மில்லியன் நிதியை வெற்றிகரமாக திரட்டியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய முதலீடு டோக்கனைஸ் செய்யப்பட்ட சொத்து சந்தையில் பணப்புழக்கத்தை விரிவுபடுத்தப் பயன்படுத்தப்படும். இந்த வளர்ச்சி நிறுவனங்களின் ஏற்பாட்டை விரைவுபடுத்தவும் பாரம்பரிய நிதி அமைப்புகளை மாற்றியமைக்கவும் உதவும் என்று துறை வல்லுநர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: Australia eyes A$14 million capital rule as crypto regulatory crackdown deepens
summary:
The proposed A$200,000 custody floor comes with asset and revenue tests and requirements for the outside custodian.
Read the full story on CryptoSlate
Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next. Get The Catalyst in your inbox
content: Australia is advancing its cryptocurrency regulatory framework with a proposed capital rule involving a custody floor, along with asset and revenue tests. The new requirements also outline specific conditions for outside custodians as the country deepens its oversight of the digital asset sector.
content_ta: கிரிப்டோகரன்சி ஒழுங்குமுறை நடவடிக்கைகளை ஆஸ்திரேலியா தீவிரப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இதன் ஒரு பகுதியாக புதிய மூலதன விதி மற்றும் காஸ்டடி வரம்பு ஆகியவைproposed செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளன. மேலும், வெளிநாட்டு காஸ்ட்டியன்கள் தொடர்பான நிபந்தனைகளும் இதில் இடம்பெற்றுள்ளன.

title: Bitcoin whale accumulation meets $760M in ETF outflows – Is BTC’s recovery at risk?
summary: Whale withdrawals are rising, but renewed ETF selling threatens to offset the tightening Bitcoin supply.
content: Bitcoin is facing mixed market signals as large whale addresses increase their accumulation, helping to tighten the available supply. However, this positive momentum is being challenged by substantial outflows from Bitcoin ETFs, which recently recorded around $760 million in withdrawals. Analysts are questioning whether these selling pressures could put the ongoing BTC recovery at risk as the market weighs tightening supply against persistent ETF selling.
content_ta: Bitcoin மார்க்கெட்டில் பெரிய வேல் முதலீட்டாளர்கள் தொடர்ந்து நாணயங்களைச் சேகரித்து வருவதால் சப்ளை குறைந்து வருகிறது. எனினும், Bitcoin ETF-களில் இருந்து சுமார் $760 மில்லியன் அளவுக்கு வெளியேற்றம் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதால் இந்த சாதகமான போக்குக்கு சவால் எழுந்துள்ளது. சப்ளை குறைவதும் ETF விற்பனை அழுத்தமும் மார்க்கெட்டின் மீட்சியை ஆபத்தில் ஆழ்த்துமா என்ற சந்தேகம் எழுந்துள்ளது.

title: Crypto Market Faces $932 Million Overnight Liquidation: XRP, DOGE, NEAR in Focus
summary: Overnight liquidations hit $932 million as XRP, DOGE, and NEAR face deep corrections before a sudden market reversal.
content: The cryptocurrency market recently experienced a massive overnight liquidation totaling $932 million. Major digital assets, including XRP, DOGE, and NEAR, faced significant price corrections before the market saw a sudden reversal. Traders and investors closely monitored the volatile price movements as billions in leveraged positions were wiped out across exchanges during the sudden market downturn.
content_ta: கிரிப்டோகரன்சி சந்தையில் ஒரே இரவில் $932 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான லிகிடேஷன் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. XRP, DOGE மற்றும் NEAR போன்ற முக்கிய டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்கள் சந்தையில் திடீர் திருப்புமுனை ஏற்படுவதற்கு முன்பு கடுமையான விலை சரிவைச் சந்தித்தன. இந்த திடீர் சந்தை வீழ்ச்சியின் போது லீவரேஜ் செய்யப்பட்ட நிலைகள் துடைத்தழிக்கப்பட்டதால் வர்த்தகர்கள் மிகுந்த எச்சரிக்கையுடன் இருந்தனர்.

title: 300 Million DOGE Moves to Binance Amid Uptober Crash
summary: Dogecoin whale activity may be rising as the ongoing market volatility pushes traders to dump their crypto holdings to hedge against further losses.
content: A massive movement of 300 million DOGE to the Binance exchange has been observed amid a broader market crash in October. This significant whale activity suggests that large investors and traders are shifting their cryptocurrency holdings, likely aiming to hedge against further market losses during a period of high volatility.
content_ta: அக்டோபர் மாத சந்தை வீழ்ச்சியின் போது 300 மில்லியன் DOGE டோக்கன்கள் Binance பரிமாற்றத்திற்கு மாற்றப்பட்டுள்ளன. இந்த பெரிய அளவிலான திமிங்கல நடவடிக்கை, சந்தை ஏற்ற இறக்கத்திலிருந்து தங்களைப் பாதுகாத்துக் கொள்ள முதலீட்டாளர்கள் தங்கள் கிரிப்டோகரன்சி இருப்புகளை மாற்றுவதைக் குறிக்கிறது.

title: Google Searches for Bitcoin Plunge to Multi-Year Lows
summary: Bitcoin is missing from Google trends as global search interest collapses to multi-year lows.
content: Global search interest for Bitcoin on Google has experienced a significant downturn, dropping to multi-year lows according to recent trends data. This sudden collapse in online searches highlights a notable waning of public curiosity and retail engagement surrounding the cryptocurrency, contrasting sharply with periods of intense market activity and broader mainstream attention in the past.
content_ta: கூகுளில் Bitcoin தொடர்பான தேடல்கள் சரிந்து பல ஆண்டுகாலக் குறைந்த அளவை எட்டியுள்ளன. உலகளவில் ஆன்லைன் தேடல் ஆர்வம் குறைந்து வருவது, இந்த cryptocurrency மீதான பொதுமக்களின் ஈடுபாடு மற்றும் ஆர்வம் கணிசமாகக் குறைந்துள்ளதை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: PNC is building its own AI factory instead of renting one
summary:
PNC's AI self-sufficiency strategy could enhance operational efficiency and cost control, potentially boosting long-term shareholder value.

content: PNC has decided to build its own proprietary artificial intelligence factory rather than renting infrastructure from third-party providers. This strategic move toward AI self-sufficiency aims to improve operational efficiency and provide better cost control. Analysts suggest this long-term approach could ultimately strengthen shareholder value as financial institutions increasingly integrate advanced technology into their core operations.
content_ta: மூன்றாம் தரப்பு வழங்குநர்களிடம் இருந்து வாடகைக்கு எடுப்பதற்குப் பதிலாக, தனது சொந்த செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு தொழிற்சாலையை உருவாக்க PNC முடிவு செய்துள்ளது. AI துறையில் சுயசார்பை அடையக்கூடிய இந்த வியூக நடவடிக்கையானது, செயல்பாட்டுத் திறனை மேம்படுத்துவதையும் செலவுக் கட்டுப்பாட்டை வழங்குவதையும் நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Meta’s Muse Spark Open AI model can run locally on Apple Mac Studio
summary:
Meta's local AI model on Mac Studios highlights a shift towards decentralized AI, enhancing privacy and control for enterprise users.

content: Meta's Muse Spark open AI model is now capable of running locally on Apple Mac Studio devices. content_ta: Meta-ன் Muse Spark open AI மாடல் இப்போது Apple Mac Studio சாதனங்களில் நேரடியாக இயக்கக் கூடிய வகையில் வந்துள்ளது. இந்த வளர்ச்சி பரவலாக்கப்பட்ட AI தொழில்நுட்பத்தை நோக்கி ஒரு முக்கியமான மாற்றத்தைக் குறிக்கிறது. கிளவுட் அடிப்படையிலான சேவைகளை மட்டும் நம்பியிராமல், நிறுவன பயனர்கள் தங்கள் தரவு மீது கூடுதல் தனியுரிமை மற்றும் கட்டுப்பாட்டைப் பெற இது உதவுகிறது.

title: Iambic Therapeutics jumps 16% in Nasdaq debut after $150M IPO
summary:
Iambic's successful IPO highlights growing investor confidence in AI-driven biotech, potentially accelerating innovation in cancer treatment.
The post Iambic Therapeutics jumps 16% in Nasdaq debut after $150M IPO appeared first on Crypto Briefing.

summary: New York State Department of Financial Services (DFS) Acting Superintendent Kaitlin Asrow announced today that Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB and its New York Branch (together, SEB or the Bank) have agreed to pay a $33 million penalty as part of a Consent Order to resolve the Department’s investigation into SEB’s compliance with New York Banking Law and anti-money laundering program failures.

content: Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB and its New York Branch have agreed to pay a $33 million penalty to the New York State Department of Financial Services. The fine resolves an investigation into the bank's compliance with New York Banking Law and anti-money laundering program failures.
content_ta: SEB மற்றும் அதன் New York Branch ஆகியவை NYDFS-க்கு $33 மில்லியன் அபராதம் செலுத்த ஒப்புக்கொண்டுள்ளன. New York Banking Law மற்றும் anti-money laundering விதிகளை மீறியது தொடர்பான விசாரணையை முடிவுக்கு கொண்டுவர இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Episode Six launches real-time backing verification for tokenised money
summary: Episode Six, a leading global technology provider of enterprise-grade card issuing and ledger infrastructure, today announced Verified Backing from the E6 Token Control Ledger.
content: Episode Six has launched Verified Backing through its E6 Token Control Ledger. This new feature provides real-time backing verification for tokenised money. The company is a prominent global technology provider specializing in enterprise-grade card issuing and ledger infrastructure, aiming to enhance security and transparency in digital currency transactions.
content_ta: Episode Six நிறுவனம் தனது E6 Token Control Ledger மூலம் Verified Backing சேவையை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த புதிய அம்சம் டோக்கன் செய்யப்பட்ட பணத்திற்கு நிகழ்நேர ஆதரவு சரிபார்ப்பை வழங்குகிறது. enterprise-grade கார்டு வெளியீடு மற்றும் ledger உள்கட்டமைப்பில் நிபுணத்துவம் பெற்ற முன்னணி உலகளாவிய தொழில்நுட்ப வழங்குநரான இந்நிறுவனம், டிஜிட்டல் நாணய பரிவர்த்தனைகளில் பாதுகாப்பையும் வெளிப்படைத்தன்மையையும் மேம்படுத்துவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Vast Bank forms payment partnership with Cliq
summary: Cliq, an innovator in financial technologies that provides merchant services, ACH and alternative payment processing, crypto and stablecoin solutions, and debit and prepaid card solutions for businesses, today announced a multi-year agreement to become a third-party payment processor (TPPP) for Vast Bank, a federally regulated nationally chartered bank.
content: Vast Bank has entered into a multi-year partnership with Cliq, a financial technology innovator offering merchant services and alternative payment processing. Under the agreement, Cliq will serve as a third-party payment processor for the federally regulated national bank. This collaboration aims to enhance payment processing capabilities, leveraging Cliq's expertise in business payment solutions, crypto and stablecoin solutions, and prepaid card services to support Vast Bank's operations.
content_ta: Vast Bank நிறுவனம், வர்த்தக சேவைகள் மற்றும் மாற்றுப் பணப் பரிமாற்றங்களை வழங்கும் financial technology நிறுவனமான Cliq உடன் பல வருட ஒப்பந்தத்தில் கையெழுத்திட்டுள்ளது. இந்த ஒப்பந்தத்தின்படி, மத்திய ஒழுங்குமுறைக்கு உட்பட்ட தேசிய வங்கியான Vast Bank-க்கு Cliq ஒரு மூன்றாம் தரப்பு பணப் பரிமாற்ற செயலாக்கியாகச் செயல்படும். வணிகப் பணப் பரிமாற்றம், crypto மற்றும் stablecoin தீர்வுகள் ஆகியவற்றில் Cliq-ன் நிபுணத்துவத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி வங்கி தனது சேவைகளை மேம்படுத்த இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு உதவும்.

title: Cross River embeds Ripple stablecoin into operating system
summary: Cross River Bank (“Cross River”), a leading technology infrastructure platform powering embedded financial solutions serving as the trust anchor for global banking and money movement, today announced it is partnering with Ripple, the leading provider of blockchain solutions across traditional and digital finance, to integrate RLUSD, its U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin, into Cross River’s proprietary Core Operating System (COS), with support for transactions on the XRP Ledger (XRPL), a public blockchain.
content: Cross River Bank has announced a partnership with Ripple to integrate the RLUSD stablecoin into its proprietary Core Operating System. This integration will also support transactions on the XRP Ledger. The collaboration combines Cross River's financial technology infrastructure with Ripple's blockchain solutions to enhance digital finance operations and money movement.
content_ta: Cross River Bank ஆனது தனது proprietary Core Operating System-ல் RLUSD stablecoin-ஐ ஒருங்கிணைக்க Ripple உடன் கூட்டு சேர்ந்துள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பு XRP Ledger-ல் பரிவர்த்தனைகளை ஆதரிக்கும். இந்த ஒத்துழைப்பு Cross River-இன் நிதி தொழில்நுட்ப உள்கட்டம在這個ை Ripple-இன் blockchain தீர்வுகளுடன் இணைத்து டிஜிட்டல் நிதி நடவடிக்கைகளை மேம்படுத்துகிறது.

title: JP Morgan Payments powers Mercado Libre’s global selling expansion
summary: Cross-border marketplace flows can introduce complexity across onboarding, funding movement, and seller pay-outs—especially when programs expand quickly across geographies. For marketplaces, embedded payments can streamline complex multi-party cross-border transactions, simplify payment operations, and improve the seller experience.
content: JP Morgan Payments is powering the global selling expansion of Mercado Libre. Cross-border marketplace flows often introduce complexities in onboarding, funding movement, and seller pay-outs, particularly during rapid geographic growth. By utilizing embedded payments, marketplaces can streamline multi-party cross-border transactions, simplify payment operations, and significantly improve the overall seller experience.
content_ta: JP Morgan Payments நிறுவனம் Mercado Libre-இன் உலகளாவிய விற்பனை விரிவாக்கத்திற்கு ஆதரவளிக்கிறது. எல்லை தாண்டிய சந்தை செயல்பாடுகள், விரைவான புவியியல் வளர்ச்சியின் போது இணைத்தல், நிதி நகர்வு மற்றும் விற்பனையாளர் கொடுப்பனவுகளில் சிக்கல்களை உருவாக்கலாம். உட்பொதிக்கப்பட்ட கட்டணங்களைப் பயன்படுத்துவதன் மூலம், சந்தைகள் பல தரப்பு எல்லை தாண்டிய பரிவர்த்தனைகளை நெறிப்படுத்தவும், கட்டண நடவடிக்கைகளை எளிதாக்கவும் முடியும்.

title: Ethiopia joins Pan-African Payment and Settlement System network
summary: The National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) and the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS) today announced that Ethiopia has officially joined the PAPSS network, marking an important milestone in the country’s integration into Africa’s financial and payments ecosystem.
content: The National Bank of Ethiopia and the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System announced that Ethiopia has officially joined the PAPSS network. This integration marks a significant milestone for the country as it connects more deeply with Africa's broader financial and payments ecosystem, facilitating improved cross-border transaction capabilities.
content_ta: National Bank of Ethiopia மற்றும் Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS) இணைந்து, Ethiopia அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக PAPSS நெட்வொர்க்கில் இணைந்ததாக அறிவித்துள்ளன. ஆப்பிரிக்காவின் நிதி மற்றும் கட்டண முறைமைக்குள் இணைவதற்கான நாட்டின் பயணத்தில் இது ஒரு முக்கியமான மைல்கல்லாகக் கருதப்படுகிறது.

title: Bloomberg equity index futures land on NinjaTrader
summary: Miami International Holdings, Inc. (MIAX®) (NYSE: MIAX), a technology-driven leader in building and operating regulated financial markets across multiple asset classes, today announced Tini® Bloomberg® 500 (B500) Index Futures and Tini Bloomberg 100 (B100) Index Futures are now available to eligible NinjaTrader Group customers.
content: Miami International Holdings announced that Tini Bloomberg 500 and Bloomberg 100 equity index futures are now available for eligible customers on the NinjaTrader platform. This integration expands trading access to these financial market instruments for users of the technology-driven brokerage service.
content_ta: Miami International Holdings நிறுவனம் தனது Tini Bloomberg 500 மற்றும் Bloomberg 100 ஈக்விட்டி இன்டெக்ஸ் ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் ஒப்பந்தங்களை NinjaTrader பிளாட்ஃபார்மில் தகுதியான வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு வழங்கியுள்ளதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது.

title: ePayments Systems Limited enters special administration
summary: If you are approached by a company offering to help you recover your money, you should proceed with caution.  For most of the firm’s clients, there will be no benefit in involving a third party in making a claim.     If you have any... Read More
content: ePayments Systems Limited has entered special administration. Clients who have been approached by external companies offering to help recover their money are advised to proceed with caution. For the majority of the firm's clients, involving a third party in the claims process provides no added benefit.
content_ta: ePayments Systems Limited சிறப்பு நிர்வாகத்தின் கீழ் கொண்டுவரப்பட்டுள்ளது. தங்கள் பணத்தை மீட்க உதவுவதாகக் கூறி வெளி நிறுவனங்கள் அணுகினால் வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் எச்சரிக்கையுடன் செயல்பட அறிவுறுத்தப்படுகிறார்கள். பெரும்பான்மையான வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு, கோரிக்கை மனுக்களில் மூன்றாம் தரப்பினரை ஈடுபடுத்துவதால் எந்தவொரு பயனும் இல்லை.

title: Dive Deposits: New venue, but JPMorgan still wants Trump suit tossed
summary: Lawyers for the bank called the plaintiffs’ allegations of blacklisting “so bare that it is impossible to determine what JPMorgan allegedly stated, when, or to whom.”
content: JPMorgan is once again asking a court to dismiss a lawsuit despite a change of venue. Lawyers for the bank argued that the plaintiffs' allegations regarding blacklisting remain far too vague, noting that it is impossible to determine what the bank allegedly stated, when, or to whom.
content_ta: JPMorgan மீதான வழக்கை தள்ளுபடி செய்ய கோரி வங்கி தரப்பு மீண்டும் நீதிமன்றத்தை அணுகியுள்ளது. பிளாக்லிஸ்டிங் தொடர்பான குற்றச்சாட்டுகள் மிகவும் தெளிவற்றவை என்றும், வங்கி என்ன கூறியது, எப்போது கூறியது அல்லது யாரிடம் கூறியது என்பதைத் தீர்மானிக்க முடியாது என்றும் வங்கியின் வழக்கறிஞர்கள் வாதிட்டனர்.

title: U.S. Bank doubles down on small-biz growth
summary: Following the recent launch of business credit cards, the Minneapolis-based lender seeks to win small-business customers by bundling services, CFO John Stern said.
content: U.S. Bank is focusing heavily on growing its small-business customer base. Following the recent introduction of new business credit cards, the Minneapolis-based lender aims to attract these clients by offering bundled services. CFO John Stern highlighted this strategic push, as the financial institution seeks to expand its market share and provide more comprehensive financial solutions to small business owners.
content_ta: U.S. Bank நிறுவனம் தனது சிறு வணிக வாடிக்கையாளர் அடிப்படையை விரிவுபடுத்துவதில் தீவிரமாக கவனம் செலுத்துகிறது. புதிய வணிக கிரெடிட் கார்டுகளை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியதைத் தொடர்ந்து, Minneapolis-ஐ தளமாகக் கொண்ட இந்த வங்கி, சேவைகளை ஒன்றிணைத்து வழங்குவதன் மூலம் வாடிக்கையாளர்களை ஈர்க்க இலக்கு நிர்ணயித்துள்ளது. CFO John Stern இந்த மூலோபாய நகர்வை முன்னிலைப்படுத்தினார்.

title: Stripe agentic commerce revs up
summary: The digital payment juggernaut’s agentic commerce activity went “vertical” last month, President John Collison said this week.
content: Stripe is seeing a significant surge in its agentic commerce activity. According to President John Collison, the digital payment company's activity in this emerging sector grew exponentially last month. This development highlights the expanding role of automated and AI-driven transactions within modern digital payment infrastructures.
content_ta: Stripe நிறுவனத்தின் agentic commerce நடவடிக்கைகள் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க அளவில் அதிகரித்துள்ளன. டிஜிட்டல் பேமெண்ட் நிறுவனத்தின் தலைவர் John Collison அவர்களின் கூற்றுப்படி, கடந்த மாதம் இந்தத் துறையில் நிறுவனத்தின் செயல்பாடு மிகப்பெரிய வளர்ச்சியைப் கண்டுள்ளது.

title: Google Says AI Isn't Building Itself Yet—Even Though It Writes 75% of the Code
summary:
AI's current progress relies heavily on human oversight and increased resources, indicating limited self-driven advancement in the field.
The post Google DeepMind finds no acceleration in AI research progress appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Google DeepMind has clarified that artificial intelligence is not yet building itself, despite generating a significant portion of its code. Recent findings indicate that AI research progress is not accelerating automatically. Instead, advancements continue to rely heavily on substantial human oversight and increased resources, showing that self-driven technological advancement remains limited for now.
content_ta: Google DeepMind நிறுவனத்தின் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு தொழில்நுட்பம் கணிசமான அளவு குறியீடுகளை எழுதினாலும், அது இன்னும் தானாகவே வளர்ச்சியை உருவாக்கிக் கொள்ளவில்லை என்று தெளிவுபடுத்தியுள்ளது. தற்போதைய AI ஆராய்ச்சிகளின் வளர்ச்சி தானாகவே துரிதப்படுத்தப்படவில்லை என்றும், மனிதர்களின் மேற்பார்வையும் கூடுதல் வளங்களும் தொடர்ந்து அவசியமாக இருப்பதாகவும் ஆய்வுகள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன.

title: Criminals steal an estimated $90M in crypto using tampered hardware wallets
summary:
The incident highlights vulnerabilities in supply chains and raises concerns about the security of crypto assets, impacting user trust and market stability.
The post Criminals steal an estimated $90M in crypto using tampered hardware wallets appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Criminals have stolen an estimated $90 million in cryptocurrency using tampered hardware wallets. This security breach highlights significant vulnerabilities within supply chains and raises serious concerns regarding the safety of digital assets. The incident impacts user trust across the market and underscores the ongoing security challenges facing the crypto industry.
content_ta: மறுசீரமைக்கப்பட்ட ஹார்டுவேர் வாலட்கள் மூலம் கிரிப்டோகரன்சி பாதுகாப்புத் துறையில் மோசடி நடந்துள்ளது. இதன் மூலம் சுமார் $90 மில்லியன் மதிப்புள்ள கிரிப்டோ திருடப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்தச் சம்பவம் சப்ளை செயின் பாதுகாப்பில் உள்ள பலவீனங்களை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுவதுடன், டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களின் பாதுகாப்பு குறித்தும் கவலையை ஏற்படுத்துகிறது.

title: Goldman Sachs: hedge funds are dumping AI stocks at a rapid clip
summary:
Hedge funds' AI stock sell-off signals a shift towards safer investments, potentially impacting mid-tier AI firms and market dynamics.
The post Goldman Sachs: hedge funds are dumping AI stocks at a rapid clip appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: According to Goldman Sachs, hedge funds are rapidly selling off their AI stocks. This significant shift indicates a move toward safer investments in the market. The trend could have a notable impact on mid-tier AI companies and broader market dynamics as investor sentiment evolves.
content_ta: Goldman Sachs-ன்படி, hedge funds நிறுவனங்கள் AI stock-களை மிக வேகமாக விற்று வருவதாகத் தகவல்கள் தெரிவிக்கின்றன. சந்தையில் பாதுகாப்பான முதலீடுகளை நோக்கி முதலீட்டாளர்கள் மாறுவதை இந்த மாற்றம் குறிக்கிறது. இந்த போக்கு mid-tier AI நிறுவனங்கள் மற்றும் சந்தை நிலவரங்களில் குறிப்பிடத்தக்க தாக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும்.

title: Tokenized stocks account for 99.3% of $14.4 billion in onchain trading outside the US
summary:
The rise of tokenized stocks highlights growing global retail demand for 24/7 trading, potentially reshaping traditional market dynamics.
The post Tokenized stocks account for 99.3% of $14.4 billion in onchain trading outside the US appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Tokenized stocks make up 99.3 percent of the 14.4 billion dollars in onchain trading volume occurring outside the United States. content_ta: Ceftin பல்வேறு தொற்றுநோய்களுக்கு சிகிச்சையளிக்க தள்ளுபடி விலையில் கிடைக்கும் மாத்திரையாகக் கிடைக்கிறது. சைனசிடிஸ் போன்ற நிலைகளுக்கு Ceftin மற்றும் பிற ஆன்டிபயாடிக் மருந்துகள் குறித்து மருத்துவ தகவல்கள் விவாதிக்கின்றன. தொற்றுகள், ஒவ்வாமை அல்லது பூஞ்சை பிரச்சினைகளால் சைனஸில் ஏற்படும் வீக்கத்திற்கு முறையான மருத்துவ ஆலோசனையும் இயற்கை தீர்வுகளும் பரிந்துரைக்கப்படுகின்றன.
